evidence.excerpt:
fix: require explicit user intent before removing existing_parts

Second root cause from the fix batch's first run (candidate 6c533be,
saved as screening-fix-live-devcal-r3-20260924): while merging the model
into owned_parts the model also emitted remove existing_parts with the
whole utterance as quote - an ungrounded key-field wrong write
(cv-owned-model-flow r2/r3).

turn's quote (intent verb + old/existing marker), otherwise downgraded
to an observation. Prompt: existing_parts (categories) and owned_parts
(exact models) coexist independently; committing a model does not imply
withdrawal. verifyAcceptedProposals and other contracts unchanged.

evidence.excerpt:
fix: ground screening evidence handling for v2 requirement collection

Four root causes from the spec6 certification (NO-GO):
- model mislabelled '那就7500吧' as accepted_proposal with no prior
  proposal (batch B cv-fps-progressive r3): prompt now fixes the
  labelling order - a value present in the current utterance is stated;
  accepted_proposal is only for adopting an actually existing prior
  assistant proposal; mislabels are still rejected per contract.
- system default budget_flex=0.1 copied into operations as user fact
  (batch B cv-composite-9000-start r2): guard downgrades stated ops whose
  value equals a numeric effective system default unless the value
  literal appears in this turn's quote; prompt forbids copying
  effective_defaults.
- owned model lost via single-segment dot path owned_parts.gpu carrying
  an object/string (batch B cv-owned-model-flow r2): normalizer now
  accepts both shapes (category must match the path, quote verbatim);
  model grounding still enforced by the reducer.
- '帮我配台电脑' written as existing_parts=[] with no purchase-scope
  evidence (batch D, human-confirmed): guard requires explicit all-new /
  no-existing-parts wording in this turn's quote before accepting an
  empty array; otherwise downgraded to an observation.

verifyAcceptedProposals is unchanged; no stated-degradation path is
restored. Adds positive/negative tests for question, refusal, no-proposal,
existing-parts and all-new boundaries. Acceptance: one capped dev+cal
Pass^3 run with the current screening model must reach >=6/7 conversation
topics, 0 key-field wrong writes, 0 vetoes; frozen gates are unchanged.
TestPrepareEmptyExistingPartsRequiresClearEvidence、TestPrepareRejectsCopiedNumericSystemDefault、TestPrepareNormalizesOwnedCategoryDotPathShapes
130 调用，多轮任务 6/7 达标、veto 0，但提交型号时无依据 remove existing_parts 导致关键字段错写 2。

feat: implement screening v2 turn contract and proposal protocol

Replace the legacy reply/next_action turn with strict operations/
observations/turn_signals/proposals/answer decoding; accept assistant
proposals only after verbatim display, same-transaction persistence,
adjacent-turn consumption and server-side verification (exact short
answers or adoption phrases carrying the proposed value; questions,
rejections and neutral utterances never write active, failed
accepted_proposal ops are never demoted to stated). Compose replies
deterministically with answer workflow/scope guards, a single domain
question group per turn and short-term presentation actions. Freeze
grader-v3 (V9 per-sentence scope-notice fix), fix three conversation
gold inconsistencies with provenance, and record the final dev/cal
Pass^3 acceptance run (16/16 frozen gate verdicts, zero vetoes).
holdout stays locked for release certification.

fix: restore first-message confirmation handoff and tighten delivery gates

r5 evidence showed the unconditional plan handoff and gate coverage gaps:

into plan, and an unknown-validation proposal could be forced to ready.
